symptoms: Auth validation latency spike, 504 Gateway Timeouts, Redis pool exhaustion warnings in logs.
root_cause: auth-service redis connection leak due to unreleased client sockets in cache middleware.
recovery_action: Restart auth-service deployment to free connections; hotfix redis pool management release mechanism.
operator_notes: Always release redis connections in a finally block.
